messages:
Maya G: quick consolidation from the postmortem — root cause looks like scheduler backpressure + aggressive autoscale cooldowns that prevented scale-up during the spike. we got token-queue buildup and GPUs filled on critical pools. posting action items below, need owners + dates. TL;DR: quota bump, scheduler tuning, formal headroom plan, recurring detection alerts.

Sanjay: can we rank these by customer impact? quota bump seems fastest to reduce outages. priority: HIGH for quota, MED for scheduler changes, LOW-MED for new alerts. @CapacityBot can you attach the short incident link? :point_up:

CapacityBot: Incident report: https://redwood.incidents/IR-2026-03-21-54 — summary + timeline attached.

Lina: I can own scheduler tuning. proposing three knobs to change immediately: reduce scale-up cooldown from 120s -> 30s, loosen backpressure threshold from 0.6 -> 0.75, and enable async provisioning for preemptible pools. will test in canary pool.

Eric: I'll take quota bump with cloud team. suggested immediate temporary increase: +20% GPU quota for prod pools A/B for 2 weeks while other mitigations land. filing request now (REQ-2391).

Devon: drafted a compact action list. putting it inline so nothing gets lost:
```
- ACTION-1 | Owner: Eric | Task: Temporary +20% GPU quota for prod A/B | Due: 2026-03-25 | Status: in-flight (REQ-2391)
- ACTION-2 | Owner: Lina | Task: Scheduler knob changes (cooldown=30s, backpressure->0.75) + canary rollout to pool-c | Due: 2026-03-28 | Status: planned
- ACTION-3 | Owner: Maya G | Task: Define headroom policy (target 12% reserve per tier, burst pool for critical routes) + docs | Due: 2026-04-02 | Status: drafting
- ACTION-4 | Owner: Sanjay | Task: Add a recurring postmortem-pattern alert in SLO dashboard (detect 3+ headroom breaches in 7d) | Due: 2026-03-30 | Status: todo
- ACTION-5 | Owner: Lina & DevOps | Task: Scheduler observability: add backpressure histogram, KV cache pressure metric | Due: 2026-04-06 | Status: todo
- ACTION-6 | Owner: Eric | Task: Canary test of quota + scheduler changes during low-traffic window; rollback plan | Due: 2026-04-01 | Status: planned
```

Maya G: thanks all. a couple of notes: 1) keep remediation concise — short-lived quota bumps > long-term config unless validated; 2) put every action into the postmortem tracker doc and mark owners in the ops board; 3) we'll do a 15-min sync tomorrow to confirm timelines.

Sanjay: @Maya G noted — I'll add the monitoring alert to the dashboard and make sure paging rules are correct.

Lina: schedule for canary rollout — can we use the Tue 03:00 UTC low-traffic window? also will include a small perf test to ensure KV cache warms correctly.

Eric: REQ-2391 submitted, cloud responded with initial approval pending usage vetting. ETA for quota increase: 6-8 hours after validation. I'll update status in tracker. :white_check_mark:

Devon: adding checklist to the incident doc now and assigning JIRA tickets for each action. I'll run the 15-min sync tomorrow at 11:00 PT — invite sent.

Maya G: perfect. last call: anyone blocked on permissions or infra access? if yes, post here now. otherwise assume owners move forward and update the thread. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
